title: Web app overlay for superocr — browser-based OCR dashboard replacing terminal
desc: Carlo's directive: build a web app for superocr that acts as an overlay reading the screen. Current state: s4 demo serves a browser page, terminal-only otherwise. Scope: (1) live OCR results display, (2) suite progress dashboard, (3) agent activity feed, (4) bus message viewer, (5) screen overlay capability. Extend existing demo into full web UI. Tech stack: lightweight (vanilla JS or minimal framework), reads from superocr API/results. Owner: marcus-aurelius (best frontend builder). Priority: 2. Parent: t-20261011-88dc (OCR epic).
